title: Discrete FIR Filter
text: Model FIR filters, 4 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {External reset} sets External state reset; {Coefficient source} sets the source of coefficients, {Filter structure}, {Coefficients} sets the filter coefficients, {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements, {Initial states} sets the initial conditions of filter states, {Show enable port} sets the create enable port, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {View Filter Response}, {Tap sum}, {Coefficients minimum} sets the minimum value of coefficients, {Coefficients maximum} sets the maximum value of coefficients, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {State}, {Output}, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.
